visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of service or topic tiles (optional icon, heading, short description, Learn more link) linking to detail pages

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: optional first cell with an icon (:icon: or small SVG image) or photo, then a body cell with heading (often linked), description and an optional link paragraph (Learn more / View All); an icon may also be the first paragraph of the body

usage: Service and industry listings across industry, service and home pages; icon feature rows (icon-features, dark); Services/Industries overview panels (dark-panels); industry pill links (bordered-grey-2)
reuseGuidance: Use for text or icon tiles that link to detail pages. icon-features centres icon tiles; bordered, bordered-grey and bordered-dark-light box each tile; bordered-grey-2 renders compact pill links; dark-panels for two large side-by-side overview panels; dark for icon tiles on a dark band. Use cards-article when tiles have a photo, date and summary.
